label: D1 after a common a1->S1 trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation step, previous reward shown), never at GO or D2. It requires that the previous trial was a1 with a common transition to S1 (rate after prev a2 is about 0.4%; a2->S1 rare does not drive it), and that the trial is late in the episode: essentially nothing before ep_trial 40, and the rate rises steadily from trial 50 to 99. The previous reward modulates it only weakly (it fires after both rewarded and unrewarded a1->S1 trials, somewhat more after reward). Magnitude grows with episode time and over runs of consecutive a1->S1c trials (example windows ramp 0.7 -> 0.9 -> 1.0), and is highest when the value head is low (it is inactive when value > ~7.5). Predicate dev: P 0.88, R 0.71, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.79. Most misses are D1 at the first trial of a window (rel -3), where prev_action is unknown in the data, so the miss is mostly a data-edge artifact: allowing unknown prev_action gives recall 0.90 and mass recall 0.97 but precision 0.65. Adding value < 7.3 raises precision to 0.92 with no F1 gain. Uses only observed variables (previous choice and transition) plus episode time.
